name: Coal reserves-to-production ratio
descriptionShort: Number of years that proved reserves of coal would last if production continued at its current rate.
descriptionProcessing: - The reserves-to-production ratio is calculated by Our World in Data as the Energy Institute Statistical Review of World Energy's proved reserves divided by its production of the same fossil fuel in the same year.
